key.name: client-id
key.description: The OAuth2 Client ID from the Discord Developer Portal (defaults to Discord StreamKit Voice ID 207646673902501888).

key.name: access-token
key.description: Optional OAuth2 access token for Discord RPC control commands.

key.name: show-member-count
key.description: Display the number of active participants in the GNOME Shell top panel.

key.name: show-disconnected-icon
key.description: Keep the status icon visible (in dimmed state) when Discord is not running or disconnected.

key.name: manual-socket-path
key.description: Exact Unix domain socket path to use for connecting to Discord IPC (e.g. /run/user/1000/discord-ipc-0).

key.name: connect-on-startup
key.description: Whether to automatically attempt connection to the manual socket when the extension starts.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Section of the GNOME top bar to place the indicator in ('left', 'center', or 'right').

key.name: panel-index
key.description: Order index of the indicator within the panel section (0 is closest to the edge).

key.name: taskbar-avatar-only
key.description: Display only circular avatars in the taskbar panel without text labels.

key.name: taskbar-icon-size
key.description: Size in pixels of the circular avatar icons in the taskbar panel.

key.name: show-taskbar-participants
key.description: Display avatar icons for voice channel participants directly in the taskbar.

key.name: taskbar-max-participants
key.description: Maximum number of participant avatar icons to show in the taskbar.

key.name: taskbar-fixed-width
key.description: Constant fixed width in pixels for the taskbar participant avatar area to prevent horizontal panel expansion and collapsing jitter (default 96px for 3 avatars; set to 0 for auto/dynamic sizing).

key.name: panel-display-mode
key.description: Display mode in the top bar: 'avatars' (show participant avatars), 'pill' (compact minimalist badge), or 'speaking-only' (only show participants when speaking).

key.name: stealth-mode
key.description: Automatically conceal the extension from the top bar completely when not connected to an active voice channel.

key.name: speaking-glow-color
key.description: CSS color hex string for the real-time active speaking glow halo (e.g. #23a55a).

key.name: mouse-middle-click-action
key.description: Action triggered by middle-clicking the panel indicator button.

key.name: mouse-right-click-action
key.description: Action triggered by right-clicking the panel indicator button.

key.name: mouse-scroll-action
key.description: Action triggered by scrolling over the panel indicator button.
